Migration record · Original file now navigation only
Migration preserves locations; it does not decide which revision to build. Open Build sources & decisions before implementing.
Old page links open their relocation notices. Use the Product map for working designs; use Retained designs to trace earlier requirements.
Exact implementation sources, design qualifications and retained behavior. A working design is not automatically approved to build.
Open the product’s entry page, then its build guide. Newer revisions do not automatically replace older requirements. Use Retained designs for lineage.
